purpose: Compose the review queue, counts, filters, rows and review modal for one BU.
behaviour: Compose the review queue, counts, filters, rows and review modal for one BU.
Render explicit empty, populated and read-only states.
Expose app/server interaction through callbacks or adapters rather than global state.
